title: DECKS AT HOME
style:
128 BPM Emotional Club Closer

(About delegation. Built like you love it.)

STYLE TAGS
128 BPM progressive build,
deep emotional chord stack,
male spoken verse,
female soaring chorus,
long euphoric drop,
end-of-set anthem
lyrics:
[INTRO — PIANO + PAD]

The decks are at home
With the lines and the ropes
With the crew you trained
With the trust you wrote

[VERSE]

You built it with hands that shook
Signed the risks nobody took
Watched it rise through doubt and rain
Took the loss, absorbed the pain

Hard to step back from the flame
Hard to let go of your name
But boats don’t grow if held too tight
They need the tide — they need the night

[CHORUS — BIG]

Let the decks run free
Let the crew hold fast
Trust the hands you trained
It will last

Pelican moving
Live Wire bright
You don’t lose it
You give it flight

[DROP — EUPHORIC]

Decks at home
Crew in place
Ocean wide
We embrace

Built with love
Held with care
Now it runs
Everywhere

[FINAL SPOKEN OUTRO]

You don’t lose control.
You multiply it.
